title: Vulcanus in Japan - A training programme for students in engineering and other scientific fields
about: Vulcanus in Japan 2027-2028: an eight-month programme in Japan, August 2027 to March 2028, for engineering and science students enrolled at universities in the EU or associated countries. The call opened 30 October 2026; online applications close 20 January 2027 at 23:00 CET.
requirements: Enrolled at a university in the EU or an associated country, with enrolment lasting at least until late June 2027
Able to commit to the full eight months
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Vulcanus in Japan - A training programme for students in engineering and other scientific fields, from the EU-Japan Centre for Industrial Cooperation, Japan, deadline 20 Jan 2027. The photo shows Tokyo Tower lit orange at sunset over the Tokyo skyline.
